dz: 阿瓦尔-拜占庭战争:阿瓦尔人解除了对托米斯的拜占庭据点的包围. 他们的首领巴扬一世在阿瓦罗-斯拉夫军队被瘟疫所毁灭后从多瑙河以北撤退.
de: Avar–Byzantine wars: The Avars lift the siege at the Byzantine stronghold of Tomis. Their leader Bayan I retreats north of the Danube River after the Avaro-Slavic army is decimated by the plague.

dz: 高古里欧-苏伊会战:针对高古里欧(朝鲜语:Korean (Korean))入侵辽西,苏伊会战皇帝文帝命其幼子杨良(由同首相高相相助)在满洲雨季征服高古里欧,由中国军队和海军出击.
de: Goguryeo-Sui War: In response to a Goguryeo (Korean) incursion into Liaoxi, Emperor Wéndi of Sui orders his youngest son, Yang Liang (assisted by the co-prime minister Gao Jiong), to conquer Goguryeo during the Manchurian rainy season, with a Chinese army and navy.
